content: Operating files live in .ai. Chats are copied by copy_chats.py. Journal entries are appended only through organize.py against journal-entry.schema.json.
Each .ai context is one module folder. The checker discovers module.json and does not keep a central list of contexts.
Foreign code is a source. Intake decision is write-here: name the owner, the spec, and a whole-behavior proof, then code it in that module. decision import is rejected by schema/intake.schema.json.

RUST_MIN_STACK not required after in-test 16MiB stack. STORE=FoundationDb cargo test -p tests --features scale -- --ignored scale_two_nodes exited 0: test cluster::scale::scale_two_nodes ... ok. Message appended on node A fetched on node B over FoundationDB, elestio/minio S3, and NATS.
License choice is BUSL-1.1. crates/main/Cargo.toml license=BUSL-1.1 and root LICENSE match. SEL blocks and enterprise defaults stay. Do not mark the project AGPL.

Next product phase is zoho-client: map hosted-mail UX onto existing JMAP, CalDAV, and directory. shippin.cloud stays not_started. Collaborative Docs stays out of scope until mail, calendar, contacts, and admin exist.
cargo build -p shippin-tech --config "build.rustc-wrapper=''" exited 0; target/debug/shippin-tech exists.
